parameters.query:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT id, capital_real, day_start_capital, day_start_date
  FROM settings ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
),
upd AS (
  UPDATE settings s
  SET day_start_capital = cur.capital_real, day_start_date = CURRENT_DATE
  FROM cur
  WHERE s.id = cur.id
    AND (cur.day_start_date IS DISTINCT FROM CURRENT_DATE)
  RETURNING s.id, s.capital_real, s.day_start_capital
)
SELECT
  cur.capital_real AS capital_real,
  COALESCE(upd.day_start_capital, cur.day_start_capital, cur.capital_real) AS day_start_capital
FROM cur
LEFT JOIN upd ON upd.id = cur.id;
